sources.title: CartPole REINFORCE — Policy Gradient from Scratch - GitHub
sources.snippet: A from-scratch implementation of the REINFORCE policy gradient algorithm in PyTorch, trained to solve the CartPole-v1 environment from Gymnasium. No RL libraries, no shortcuts — every line of the training loop, the loss function, and the reward computation is written and understood from first ...

sources.title: CartPole with Policy Gradient (REINFORCE) - GitHub
sources.snippet: Implements the REINFORCE algorithm from scratch to solve the CartPole-v1 environment. The agent observes 4 state variables (cart position, cart velocity, pole angle, pole angular velocity) and learns to output a policy — a probability distribution over actions (push left or push right).

sources.title: Policy Gradient for CartPole | rlcode/reinforcement-learning | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The REINFORCE implementation for CartPole demonstrates a fundamental policy gradient method that directly learns a stochastic policy for action selection. This approach differs from value-based methods by learning the policy directly, making it suitable for continuous action spaces and problems where the optimal policy is stochastic.

sources.title: Project: REINFORCE on CartPole - Deep Reinforcement Learning
sources.snippet: Before we begin Implement REINFORCE — Monte Carlo policy gradients — on CartPole-v1. You optimize the policy directly (no Q-table), using full-episode returns and the log-probability trick from Module 5.
